attributes.description: Praj Industries Ltd., founded in 1983 is a leading biotechnology and engineering company globally. It offers sustainable solutions in bioenergy, water purification, process equipment, breweries, and wastewater treatment. Company is focused on the environment , energy and farm-to-fuel technology solution. Company has global offices in Thailand, Philippines, and the USA.[1]
